video_title: Why Bitcoin Traders Are Watching OpenAI, Sam Altman & Polymarket | The BluePrint

quotes.speaker: Nick Tomaino
quotes.summary_phrase: Nick Tomaino on the lack of transparency in traditional finance
quotes.excerpt: no one understands how the traditional financial system really works. It's like dollars can just be printed
quotes.quote: No one understands how the traditional financial system really works. It's like dollars can just be printed out of nowhere. There's no transparency around how much money is gonna be printed a year from now. It's just a few people that can print more if they decide to.

quotes.speaker: Nick Tomaino
quotes.summary_phrase: Nick Tomaino on the transparency of Bitcoin's code
quotes.excerpt: in crypto, it's like Bitcoin, you can understand exactly how the system works
quotes.quote: In crypto, it's like Bitcoin, you can understand exactly how the system works. You could understand the money supply.

quotes.speaker: Nick Tomaino
quotes.summary_phrase: Nick Tomaino on the risks of focusing only on money
quotes.excerpt: if you focus too much on the money, you're probably gonna lose it
quotes.quote: If you focus too much on the money, you're probably gonna lose it. You're not gonna make a lot of money if it's just that. You gotta believe in something more.

quotes.speaker: Nick Tomaino
quotes.summary_phrase: Nick Tomaino on the lack of transparency in closed-source systems
quotes.excerpt: like Facebook or Google, the code is closed source. With Bitcoin, the code is open source
quotes.quote: Like Facebook or Google, the code is closed source. With Bitcoin, the code is open source. How the system works is completely transparent and smart developers can study it.

quotes.speaker: Nick Tomaino
quotes.summary_phrase: Nick Tomaino on the shifting trust in institutions
quotes.excerpt: people are starting to realize that the institutions shouldn't be trusted at all
quotes.quote: Most people in the world still believe in institutions for trust. I think that's changing and I think that's a big part of why the future is just increasingly crypto because I think people are starting to realize that the institutions shouldn't be trusted at all.

quotes.speaker: Nick Tomaino
quotes.summary_phrase: Nick Tomaino on losing his net worth in a phishing attack
quotes.excerpt: I had all my money in Bitcoin on Coinbase and I got hacked
quotes.quote: I had all my money in Bitcoin on Coinbase and I got hacked. It was a phishing attack. I lost my entire net worth. I had my guard down, they caught me slipping, clicked the link and boom, my entire funds were stolen.

quotes.speaker: Nick Tomaino
quotes.summary_phrase: Nick Tomaino on the difference between AI and crypto
quotes.excerpt: I view right now the current form of AI as human control technology and crypto as human empowerment
quotes.quote: I view right now the current form of AI as human control technology and crypto as human empowerment technology.

quotes.speaker: Nick Tomaino
quotes.summary_phrase: Nick Tomaino on the lack of transparency at OpenAI
quotes.excerpt: OpenAI is not open and transparent at all
quotes.quote: The company behind ChatGPT is OpenAI. In the name, it sounds like it's open and transparent, but OpenAI is not open and transparent at all.

quotes.speaker: Nick Tomaino
quotes.summary_phrase: Nick Tomaino on the role of stablecoins in US dollar adoption
quotes.excerpt: stablecoins allow the government to bring dollars directly to the people without buy-in from their governments
quotes.quote: Stablecoins allow the government to bring dollars directly to the people without buy-in from their governments. It's an internet-native direct way to get dollar adoption.

quotes.speaker: Nick Tomaino
quotes.summary_phrase: Nick Tomaino on the motivations of Michael Saylor
quotes.excerpt: he's a 62-year-old dude with no family that is just solessly chasing more money, more attention
quotes.quote: He's a 62-year-old dude with no family that is just solessly chasing more money, more attention and I don't think actually believes in any of the values of crypto.

quotes.speaker: Nick Tomaino
quotes.summary_phrase: Nick Tomaino on Vitalik Buterin's vision for Ethereum
quotes.excerpt: Vitalik, who founded Ethereum, he wanted to write code on top of Bitcoin that would enable applications
quotes.quote: Vitalik, who founded Ethereum, he wanted to write code on top of Bitcoin that would enable applications. Things that we now know of like stablecoins, real-world assets on chain, NFTs, and decentralized finance. All this innovation that has happened in the past 10 years now, it's happened on Ethereum.

quotes.speaker: Nick Tomaino
quotes.summary_phrase: Nick Tomaino on the lack of developer platforms on Twitter
quotes.excerpt: Twitter has long been an important social network, but it's never really had a thriving developer platform
quotes.quote: Twitter has long been an important social network, but it's never really had a thriving developer platform because it's had APIs, but then if the developers were doing things that conflicted with the business of Twitter, the company could just rug pull it.

quotes.speaker: Nick Tomaino
quotes.summary_phrase: Nick Tomaino on his early experience with Bitcoin
quotes.excerpt: I bought my first Bitcoin at $3 per coin
quotes.quote: I bought my first Bitcoin at $3 per coin. I first saw a Wired article talking about this magic internet money that was being used to buy guns and drugs. That was the early media narrative, so I was just curious.

quotes.speaker: Nick Tomaino
quotes.summary_phrase: Nick Tomaino on the shared beliefs of the early crypto community
quotes.excerpt: they were aligned by two things: shared beliefs and economic incentives
quotes.quote: They were aligned by two things: shared beliefs and economic incentives. They all believed in the values of Bitcoin, things I'm talking about like transparency, and they all also owned Bitcoin.

quotes.speaker: Nick Tomaino
quotes.summary_phrase: Nick Tomaino on the importance of getting to know project founders
quotes.excerpt: I think if you know the people, it might change your mind about a narrative
quotes.quote: I think if you know the people, it might change your mind about a narrative. You can tell by spending time with someone, someone's vibe, and whether they're actually like a genuine person or not.

quotes.speaker: Nick Tomaino
quotes.summary_phrase: Nick Tomaino on the risks of AI centralization
quotes.excerpt: I view right now the current form of AI as human control technology
quotes.quote: I view right now the current form of AI as human control technology. People are giving a lot of data to that company and that company has increasingly a lot of power because the product is really good.

quotes.speaker: Nick Tomaino
quotes.summary_phrase: Nick Tomaino on the importance of transparency in AI
quotes.excerpt: I would like to see AI companies specifically that have more transparency, that have open algorithms
quotes.quote: I would like to see AI companies specifically that have more transparency, that have open algorithms, that have open data.

quotes.speaker: Nick Tomaino
quotes.summary_phrase: Nick Tomaino on the potential for AI-driven conspiracy
quotes.excerpt: he's said that he's discovered this conspiracy where there's a non-governmental organization and ChatGPT has led him to this
quotes.quote: He's said that he's discovered this conspiracy where there's a non-governmental organization and ChatGPT has led him to this. There's a non-governmental organization that like suppresses narratives and controls people.

quotes.speaker: Nick Tomaino
quotes.summary_phrase: Nick Tomaino on the importance of understanding cryptocurrency supply
quotes.excerpt: you should understand exactly the supply of the cryptocurrency
quotes.quote: You should understand exactly the supply of the cryptocurrency. How much of the cryptocurrency was allocated to insiders initially? That's something that not enough people think about.

quotes.speaker: Nick Tomaino
quotes.summary_phrase: Nick Tomaino on the value of Polymarket's open data
quotes.excerpt: the result of that is like market information that can often be more truthful than the media narrative
quotes.quote: The result of that is like market information that can often be more truthful than the media narrative. Polymarket as a brand is increasingly resonating with young people in particular because it's an open market where people with skin in the game can just put their money where their mouth is.
